thread:
Anna - Quick design review: timeline scrub feels crowded when multiple rollouts overlap. Suggest compact rows + hover to expand.
Mike - Agree, main concern is discoverability of the canary allocation slider. Can we try a callout state? :thinking:
Lee - I prototyped a slim mode where each version shows a 24px tall row, expands on hover or focus. Works with keyboard? still iterating.
Sarah - a11y: hover-only reveals are bad. Need focus states and aria-expanded. Slider must be operable by keyboard with visible focus ring.
Anna - Good call. For animations when expanding, keep under 200ms and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Mike - Copy question: instead of "Canary allocation" what about "Traffic split"? Shorter and clearer?
Lee - "Traffic split" might be ambiguous for some users. Maybe use a short helper: "Percent of traffic to this version" shown on hover/focus.
Anna - UX nits: rollback action sits too close to timestamp; risk of accidental clicks. Propose moving it into a kebab menu and require a confirmation modal with mandatory reason field for audit.
Sarah - Modal must have role="dialog" and a clear h2. Confirm button text should be explicit: "Rollback to v3 and notify team". Ensure focus trap.
deploy-bot - Canary started: rollout id rl_23892, 5% allocation. Logs: https://ci.redwood/rollouts/rl_23892
Mike - Nice. Also request: toast when canary starts that links to the timeline. Courtney wanted quick access in the last sync.
Lee - Will add toast + deep link. For slim timeline, add micro-badges for status (warming, healthy, degraded) with color plus title attribute for screen readers.
Anna - Design ask: include historical snapshot chevrons so users can open a version diff side-by-side. Make chevrons high-contrast and big enough to hit.
Sarah - Status green #0f9d58 is borderline for small badges. Recommend #0a8a42 and minimum 12px text inside badges; provide aria-labels.
Mike - Acceptance criteria: 1) keyboard nav through versions 2) visible focus ring on expand 3) rollback modal with required reason logged 4) slider accessible by keyboard 5) compact/slim mode toggle in user prefs.
Anna - Updating Figma with slim rows and rollback modal; pushing a new artboard now.
Lee - Pushing CSS and keyboard handlers in pr/422. Snippet: 
``
.role-switch:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); }
.slider { --thumb-size: 20px; }
```
Sarah - Small nit for slider: add aria-valuetext="5 percent" and aria-label="canary traffic percent". Also ensure screenreader announces live percent changes.
Mike - Can we do a small internal usability test with 4–6 PMs to validate the slim timeline before enabling it org-wide?
Anna - Good plan. I'll add a 10-minute test script and tag Courtney. :calendar:
Lee - OK going to merge after unit tests and quick keyboard pass tomorrow.
Anna - Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
